item.description:

I picked it all up on Saturday 15/08 and bagged it all up in 2 empty compost bags. I also picked wrappers and empty cans … I would be grateful if these bags could be collected ? I have left the bags at the top of the alleyway With thanks

item.title: Corner of Dunster & Plympton, 17th August
item.description:
Dumped mattress and other household waste obstructing the pavement. This corner is repeatedly used as a fly-tipping point and the problem has been ongoing for some time. Please consider stronger enforcement, including investigation and prosecution where possible, as well as clearer public information about how residents should dispose of mattresses, bulky items and other household waste. Better signage or communication in this area may also help, as some people appear to assume that items left on the pavement will simply be collected.

Nearest address to the pin placed on the map (from OS Places API): Plympton Road, London
Report on FixMyStreet
